creativity.reason: Level 1: rests on general language only; the business is tobacco manufacturing, and creative work appears only as a routine input (brand marketing and advertising).

community.reason: Level 3: external education and community investment with substantial measured reach (SETC 108,000 trained, SKB vocational >9,000, 1,300 scholarship students, SAR 215,000 beneficiaries); not clearly central to the tobacco business strategy, so 4 is not met.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: a specific disability-inclusion practice with no reach figures; the rest is women-in-leadership statistics and equal-opportunity language.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 3: named enabling programs with substantial measured reach (SETC mentoring and training, SRC/AYO digital tools for 250,000 small stores, WEC for 1,000+ women entrepreneurs); not a revenue-generating business line, so 4 is not met.

red_flags.quote: Berawal sebagai perusahaan keluarga sederhana pada tahun 1913, Perseroan kini telah berkembang menjadi perusahaan tembakau terkemuka di Indonesia.
red_flags.quote_en: What began as a humble family company in 1913 has since grown into Indonesia's leading tobacco company.
red_flags.section: Annual report > Report of the Board of Directors
red_flags.explanation: Manufacturing and trading cigarettes and tobacco products is the core business (one operating segment, 99.6% of net revenues).

red_flags.quote: Dari seluruh laporan, 36 laporan memiliki bukti yang cukup bagi Perseroan untuk memberi sanksi kepada karyawan bersangkutan.
red_flags.quote_en: Of all reports, 36 had sufficient evidence for the Company to sanction the employees concerned.
red_flags.section: Annual report > Corporate Governance > Code of Conduct / Speak Up
red_flags.explanation: The internal Ethics & Compliance process substantiated 36 cases in 2025. Case types are not broken out and may be mostly non-rights matters such as fraud. No finding by a court, regulator or outside body is disclosed, so this costs no points.

ai.notes: Core business is tobacco: one segment, 99.6% of net revenue. SRC is a real support program for small retailers, but it is also the company's route-to-market channel for its own cigarettes, which tempers the Entrepreneurship score. The 43 Third Party Operators owned by local entrepreneurs and cooperatives are contract manufacturing (serving, not enabling), so they are not scored. The Rembang children's program lists arts and culture as one component among many; this was too incidental to score Creativity above 1. Sampoerna Parents Community is an employee group about parenting, not a cross-cultural network, so it is not scored. The SmartWork flexible-working program was replaced by a full return-to-office in 2025 (past). Sampoerna Karya Bangsa took on job training as its business activity in March 2025. The Pasuruan Entrepreneurship Week (200 displaced workers) and SETC Collaborator Hub (20 collaborators) are part of SETC and not counted separately. The SETC figure is cumulative since 2007. The 1,300 scholarship figure is cumulative 2010-2025.
